_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. Do not copy this file over your real config.
Your real file is: C:\Users\<your-name>\.zcode\cli\config.json
JSON has no comments, so this _comment block is just data key that ZCode
ignores. Delete it once you have what you need.
How to use this file:
1. Close ZCode.
2. Back up your real config.json.
3. Copy ONLY the server objects you want, into the mcp.servers object
of your real config.json. Do not replace the whole file - it also
holds your model providers and plugin settings.
4. Validate the JSON, then reopen ZCode.
Rules that prevent almost every failure:
- Forward slashes in paths, never backslashes.
- A comma between entries, none after the last one.
- Back the file up, and confirm the change survived a restart.
On the pinned version below: mcp-remote@0.14.2 is deliberate. Without a
version number, npx downloads whatever is newest each time it starts, so the
code running on your machine can change without you seeing it. To update,
change the number in purpose, restart ZCode, and check the server still works.
See the Security section of reference/mcp-servers.md.
Check the npx path on your machine with:  where.exe npx
